Pregnancy Due Date Calculator

Choose whichever date you know: your last menstrual period, the conception date, or an ultrasound scan date. The tool works out the estimated due date, the gestational age as of today, and the start and end dates of all three trimesters.

Important

The due date from this tool is a statistical estimate, not a prediction and not medical advice. Only a small minority of babies are born on their due date. Dating from the menstrual cycle is less reliable than an early ultrasound measurement; if your clinician gives a different date, the clinical dating prevails.
